_note: Register of ambiguous job titles. These rows stay labelled as the dataset labels them, but the alternative reading is legitimate B2B behaviour, so they are reported as boundary cases instead of being forced by keyword hacks.

cases.note: Erecting/dismantling scaffolding is generic site labour, but a scaffold carpenter legitimately owns the same wording.

Post-tensioning strand work sits with rebar/reinforcement, while a structural ironworker welds. Both readings exist on site, so the ambiguous bare word `ironworker` was only removed from the hard rule layer, not rewritten case by case.

Hazmat removal and radiological safety overlap; the safety-inspection reading is legitimate.
Manual loading vs machine loading. Vocabulary was extended with `loader`/`mover`, but a `wheel loader operator` task is still resolved to equipment.
Vehicle cleaning is labour, yet the word `truck` pulls towards the operator trade; both readings survive in production wording.
